main.description: A Streamplace user's bio: a long-form 'about' description, pinned social links, and a customizable layout of blocks.

description.description: Long-form 'about' text shown in the bio header. Distinct from the user's bsky profile description, which is shorter.

socials.description: Pinned social/platform links shown in the bio header.

layout.description: How the customizable body of the bio is arranged. Currently only the columns layout is defined; future layouts (e.g. canvas, grid) can be added here.

importedFrom.description: Optional reference to an external authoring source (e.g. a pub.leaflet.document) this bio was imported/translated from. Clients may use this to offer a 're-import' action.

description.description: Long-form rich text describing the user.

facets.description: Annotations of the description text (mentions, URLs, etc).
